description: Review of the stability epic (the four mechanical checks, the deprecation helper and the process) found the checks catch the loud failures and miss the quiet ones. Children: a mechanical guard that no existing frozen file changes in a PR, a marker in the ledger that a retired code stays retired, and the extractor's format contract written down (one ticket); the freeze task writes the API snapshot from the tag so the release step cannot omit an addition (one ticket); a frozen sample of the test suite's kernels with recorded inputs and outputs so meaning has an anchor beyond the doc examples (one ticket). Done when the three are merged.
title: [EPIC] Stability checks: close the gaps found in review
